title: Enhancing LLMs for Governance with Human Oversight: Evaluating and Aligning LLMs on Expert Classification of Climate Misinformation for Detecting False or Misleading Claims about Climate Change

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot and fine-tuned LLM classifications of climate change claims against expert annotations to identify skewed distributions and misclassifications (e.g., inaccurately classifying claims about climate impacts on animal and plant species as false) caused by under-representation in the fine-tuning dataset.

Evaluating the model on real-world social media data with expert human annotators to reveal the model's inability to classify claims (e.g., health impacts of climate change) that were systematically excluded from or fell outside the ideological scope of the original training taxonomy.
